item.title: Australian woman challenges murder convictions in mushroom poisoning case
item.description: Erin Patterson, convicted of killing four relatives with death cap mushrooms, appeals her triple murder sentence.

item.title: Trump announces temporary halt on new Canada tariffs
item.description: President Trump said he is pausing the upcoming 50% tariffs on Canadian goods, citing a U.S.-Canada agreement.

item.title: South Korea to end U.S. military exercise early after Trump criticism
